items.headline: City weighs possible legal action against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss potential litigation involving fire apparatus manufacturers Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association.

items.headline: Council held study session on Highway 17 congestion relief
items.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council held a study session on the State Route 17 Corridor Congestion Relief Project, addressing traffic congestion on the highway that connects Los Gatos to Santa Cruz.
